title: Runs
description: Central orchestration table for Tribunus compute evidence. Each row corresponds to one benchmark execution — a single model, quantization, backend, and hardware combination producing a set of timing and memory observations.

run_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this run. Primary key referenced by all other tables.

quantization.description: Quantization scheme applied to the model weights.

hardware_id.description: Foreign key into the hardware_profiles table identifying the physical machine.

num_tokens.description: Number of output tokens generated during this run.

tokens_per_second.description: Median generation throughput in tokens per second.

peak_memory_mb.description: Peak memory usage during generation in megabytes.

tribunus_commit.description: Full Git SHA of the Tribunus compute kernel at time of execution.

repo_dirty.description: True if the Git working tree had uncommitted changes at execution time.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this table schema at time of insertion.

dataset_release.description: Release tag of the published corpus snapshot (e.g. '2026-06').

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the primary output artifact.
